item.title: 'To foreigners, please leave Japan': Xenophobic notes left at M'sian teacher's home in Japan
item.description: A 24-year-old Malaysian man was disheartened when he returned to his home in Japan to find xenophobic notes asking him to leave the country.

item.title: Man in M'sia charged with rape of 15-year-old girl, cut contact with victim after promising marriage
item.description: A 23-year-old man in Johor was charged with allegedly raping a 15-year-old girl, whom he had also promised marriage.

item.title: Huge construction scaffolding falls & crushes car in M'sia, driver survives unharmed
item.description: A metal scaffolding in Malaysia suddenly collapsed and crushed a car. The driver somehow escaped unharmed.

item.title: Australian with dual citizenship fined S$2.4K for failing to present S'pore passport when entering S'pore
item.description: A Singaporean man with Australian citizenship was fined S$2,400 for failing to present his Singapore passport when entering Singapore.

item.title: Man in China detained for assaulting his 92-year-old mother after minor argument
item.description: A man in China has been detained after a video showing him assaulting his over-90-year-old mother went viral on Chinese social media.

item.title: 5 facts about Gavin Lee, the coach who finally led S'pore to Asian Cup qualification on merit
item.description: Singapore has done the unthinkable and qualified for the AFC Asian Cup for the first time based on merit, thanks to head coach Gavin Lee.

item.title: GrabRewards is now GrabCoins, earn up to 5% back while saving on rides, food & everyday spends
item.description: What used to be GrabRewards points is now GrabCoins, a new way for users to earn and save across their favourite Grab services.

item.title: More & longer planned MRT closures needed in future to keep trains reliable: Jeffrey Siow
item.description: Acting Transport Minister Jeffrey Siow said that Singaporeans should expect longer and more frequent MRT closures to maintain reliability.

item.title: 2-year-old in Thailand found dead with severe wounds near home, police investigating
item.description: A two-year-old boy in Rayong, Thailand, was found dead on the roadside near his home, after going missing under a neighbour's care.

item.title: Monitor lizard devours endangered mud lobster at Sungei Buloh after splitting prey into 2
item.description: A monitor lizard split an endangered mud lobster into two at Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve before quickly swallowing the crustacean.
